home.title: My balance
home.description: One balance per credit type, to use at merchants that accept this type.
home.requests: {count, plural, one {# payment request to confirm} other {# payment requests to confirm}}

pay.title: Pay
pay.description: Show your code to the merchant, or pay by scanning the merchant's code.
pay.codeHint: Show this QR or read the code to the merchant. Valid 60 seconds, single use.
pay.expired: Code expired: show a new one.
pay.requestsEmpty: No pending request. It will appear here as soon as the merchant enters your code.
pay.scanVideo: Camera: aim at the merchant's QR
pay.scanUnsupported: Scanning is not available in this browser: enter the merchant code.
pay.scanDenied: Camera refused: allow it or enter the merchant code.
pay.scanInvalid: This QR is not a FlexiPay merchant QR.
pay.merchantCodeHint: Shown at the checkout, under the FlexiPay QR.
pay.demoError: The demo request failed. Try again.

pin.label: PIN (4 digits)
pin.hint: Your PIN is never shown or stored.

history.title: History
history.description: Your payments, credits received and expiries.

profile.title: My profile
profile.description: Your details, provided by your company.
profile.name: Name
profile.languageHint: Choose the language of the app.
profile.note: To change these details, contact your company.

security.title: Security
security.description: Protect your account and your payments.
security.mfaOn: On: a 6-digit code is asked at every sign-in.
security.recoveryHint: Generate new recovery codes: the old ones will stop working.
security.newCodesHint: Write them down now and keep them safe: they will not be shown again.
security.pinMismatch: The two PINs do not match.

family.title: My family
family.description: Up to {max} accounts for your relatives. You transfer part of your credit to them and can take it all back at any time.
family.addHint: The member gets a login and a temporary password, shown only once.
family.transferHint: The credit keeps its type and its expiry date. No fee.
family.typeHint: Only your balance of this type is debited.
family.endsOnHint: After this date, the member no longer pays with this type; take the rest back.
family.reclaimMessage: All the credit {name} can still use comes back to your account.
family.deleteMessage: The credit of {name} first comes back to your account, then their access is closed.
family.deleted: {name} deleted; their credit came back to your account.
family.full: You reached the maximum of {max} members.
family.disabled: Your company switched family accounts off: you can only take your members’ credit back.
family.credentialsNotice: This password is shown only once. Give it to your relative: they will change it at the first sign-in.
